## Data Acquisition

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
library(httr2)
library(fs)
library(gt)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

DATA_DIR <- fs::path("data", "mp03")
fs::dir_create(DATA_DIR, recurse = TRUE)

# Nepalese in table B02018 (Asian alone or in any combination, by group).
# Checked for 2024 ACS-1 and ACS-5: B02018_024 = "South Asian: Nepalese".
# NOTE: this number changed between years (it was B02018_016 in 2021),
# so re-check it if you switch to a different year.
GROUP_VAR <- "B02018_024"
ACS_YEAR  <- 2024
```

```{r}
#| label: acs-cache-helper
# Same caching idea as MP02: only hit the API if the file isn't saved yet.
# To refresh (e.g. after adding variables), delete the matching .rds file.
get_acs_cached <- function(file_name, ...){
    file_path <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, paste0(file_name, ".rds"))

    if(!fs::file_exists(file_path)){
        result <- get_acs(...)
        saveRDS(result, file_path)
    }

    readRDS(file_path)
}
```

### Metro Area (CBSA) Population

```{r}
#| label: task1-cbsa
# Task 1: total population and Nepalese population for every metro area (ACS-1)
cbsa_pop <- get_acs_cached(
    "cbsa_nepalese_acs1",
    geography = "cbsa",
    variables = c(total = "B01003_001", nepalese = GROUP_VAR),
    year      = ACS_YEAR,
    survey    = "acs1",
    output    = "wide"
) |>
    mutate(nepalese_share = nepaleseE / totalE)

# Full B02018 table for every metro, used for the ancestry-mix question (Q5)
cbsa_asian_groups <- get_acs_cached(
    "cbsa_b02018_acs1",
    geography = "cbsa",
    table     = "B02018",
    year      = ACS_YEAR,
    survey    = "acs1"
)

# Variable labels, so B02018_0xx codes can be turned into group names
acs1_vars <- {
    f <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, "acs1_variables.rds")
    if(!fs::file_exists(f)) saveRDS(load_variables(ACS_YEAR, "acs1"), f)
    readRDS(f)
}

# National total, used for the "share of all US Nepalese" question (Q6)
us_pop <- get_acs_cached(
    "us_nepalese_acs1",
    geography = "us",
    variables = c(total = "B01003_001", nepalese = GROUP_VAR),
    year      = ACS_YEAR,
    survey    = "acs1",
    output    = "wide"
)
```

### NYC Census Tract Population

```{r}
#| label: task2-tracts
# Task 2: same variables at tract level for the 5 NYC counties (ACS-5), with shapes
NYC_COUNTIES <- c("New York", "Kings", "Queens", "Bronx", "Richmond")

nyc_tracts <- get_acs_cached(
    "nyc_tracts_nepalese_acs5",
    geography = "tract",
    state     = "NY",
    county    = NYC_COUNTIES,
    variables = c(total = "B01003_001", nepalese = GROUP_VAR),
    year      = ACS_YEAR,
    survey    = "acs5",
    output    = "wide",
    geometry  = TRUE
)
```

### NYC Neighborhood Tabulation Areas

```{r}
#| label: task3-nta
# Task 3: download, unzip and read the 2020 NTA shapefile (not via tidycensus)
load_nyc_nta <- function(){
    # TODO: if this URL fails, go to the NYC Planning NTA page, right-click the
    # first "Download Files" button under "2020 Neighborhood Tabulation Areas",
    # choose "Copy link", and paste it here. The version letters change over time.
   NTA_URL <- "https://s-media.nyc.gov/agencies/dcp/assets/files/zip/data-tools/bytes/neighborhood-tabulation-areas/nynta2020_26c.zip"
    zip_file <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, "nynta2020.zip")

    if(!fs::file_exists(zip_file)){
        request(NTA_URL) |>
            req_headers(
                `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0"
            ) |>
            req_retry(max_tries = 4) |>
            req_perform(path = zip_file)
    }

    shp_file <- fs::dir_ls(DATA_DIR, recurse = TRUE, glob = "*nynta2020*.shp")

    if(length(shp_file) == 0){
        unzip(zip_file, exdir = DATA_DIR)
        shp_file <- fs::dir_ls(DATA_DIR, recurse = TRUE, glob = "*nynta2020*.shp")
    }

    st_read(shp_file[1], quiet = TRUE) |>
        # NTAType: 0 = residential neighborhood; other codes are parks,
        # airports, cemeteries etc. Kept so those can be filtered out later.
        select(BoroName, NTA2020, NTAName, NTAType)
}

nyc_nta <- load_nyc_nta()
```

### Aggregating Tracts to Neighborhoods

```{r}
#| label: task4-tract-to-nta
# Task 4: give each tract the NTA it overlaps most, then add tracts up per NTA.
# 2020 NTAs are built from whole 2020 tracts, so largest = TRUE is a clean match.
nyc_tracts <- st_transform(nyc_tracts, st_crs(nyc_nta))

tract_to_nta <- nyc_tracts |>
    st_join(nyc_nta, join = st_intersects, largest = TRUE)

nta_pop <- tract_to_nta |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    group_by(NTA2020) |>
    summarize(
        total    = sum(totalE, na.rm = TRUE),
        nepalese = sum(nepaleseE, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups  = "drop"
    )

nta_data <- nyc_nta |>
    left_join(nta_pop, by = "NTA2020") |>
    mutate(nepalese_share = nepalese / total)
```

### NYC PLUTO (Tax Lot Data)

```{r}
#| label: task5-pluto
# Task 5: page through the PLUTO API and save one CSV (cached like MP02)
load_pluto <- function(){
    PLUTO_FILE <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, "pluto.csv")

    if(!fs::file_exists(PLUTO_FILE)){
        BASE_URL  <- "https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/64uk-42ks.csv"
        # Only the columns needed later
        PLUTO_COLS <- c("bbl", "borough", "bct2020", "landuse",
                        "lotarea", "bldgarea", "comarea", "resarea",
                        "officearea", "retailarea",
                        "unitsres", "unitstotal", "numfloors")
        PAGE_SIZE <- 50000
        offset    <- 0
        pages     <- list()

        repeat {
            page <- request(BASE_URL) |>
                req_url_query(
                    `$select` = paste(PLUTO_COLS, collapse = ","),
                    `$order`  = "bbl",          # fixed order so pages don't overlap
                    `$limit`  = PAGE_SIZE,
                    `$offset` = offset
                ) |>
                req_retry(max_tries = 4) |>
                req_perform() |>
                resp_body_string() |>
                read_csv(col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))

            if(nrow(page) == 0) break
            pages[[length(pages) + 1]] <- page
            if(nrow(page) < PAGE_SIZE) break
            offset <- offset + PAGE_SIZE
        }

        bind_rows(pages) |> write_csv(PLUTO_FILE)
    }

    read_csv(
        PLUTO_FILE,
        col_types = cols(
            bbl = col_character(), borough = col_character(),
            bct2020 = col_character(), landuse = col_character(),
            .default = col_double()
        )
    )
}

pluto <- load_pluto()

# bct2020 = borough digit + 6-digit tract (e.g. 1000100).
# Convert to the Census GEOID (e.g. 36061000100) so PLUTO can join to tracts.
BORO_TO_COUNTY <- c("1" = "061", "2" = "005", "3" = "047", "4" = "081", "5" = "085")

pluto <- pluto |>
    mutate(
        bct2020 = str_remove(bct2020, "\\.0+$"),
        GEOID   = paste0("36",
                         BORO_TO_COUNTY[str_sub(bct2020, 1, 1)],
                         str_sub(bct2020, 2))
    )

# One row per tract with building totals, for the EDA questions
tract_buildings <- pluto |>
    filter(!is.na(bct2020)) |>
    group_by(GEOID) |>
    summarize(
        office_area = sum(officearea, na.rm = TRUE),
        res_area    = sum(resarea,    na.rm = TRUE),
        com_area    = sum(comarea,    na.rm = TRUE),
        bldg_area   = sum(bldgarea,   na.rm = TRUE),
        res_units   = sum(unitsres,   na.rm = TRUE),
        max_floors  = max(numfloors,  na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups     = "drop"
    )
```

```{r}
#| label: data-check
# Quick sanity checks: run these and look at the numbers before moving on
tibble(
    check = c("Metros", "NYC tracts", "NTAs", "PLUTO lots",
              "PLUTO tracts matched to Census tracts"),
    value = c(nrow(cbsa_pop), nrow(nyc_tracts), nrow(nyc_nta), nrow(pluto),
              sum(tract_buildings$GEOID %in% nyc_tracts$GEOID))
) |>
    gt()
```
